interpretation: The initial 30-company 1 RPS and 60-company 2 RPS collectors completed without the previously observed common Invalid argument tunnel 503.
Generic HTTP 503 can reduce the collector global RPS even when no common transport failure is observed; this is a collector response, not evidence of an external published quota.
RPS, concurrency and elapsed cooling may affect the route, but these observations do not establish causality or a Codex Cloud public/safe request threshold.

New http_get_started_at is captured immediately before requests.get after waits; http_response_received_at is after requests.get returns headers, not a network packet trace or server-side arrival log.
Old retrieved_at preceded waits. No actual dispatch RPS for the old 8/24 worker period is calculated retrospectively from that field.

Saved requests can be incomplete, especially while a collector is running or where redirected intermediate robots evidence was not retained. Collector totals are authoritative for the GET-attempt counts, and timing metrics describe only the saved starts.
RateLimit/Retry-After absence in saved responses does not prove that no intermediary rate limiting exists.
This snapshot is an intermediate observation; a later completed survey may be compared in a separately dated update.
Common Invalid argument 503 recurred during the 1.92 RPS batch after a reduction to 1.536 RPS; the three failures were followed by automatic rate reductions to 0.768, 0.384 and the 0.25 RPS floor.

After 5-minute and 15-minute cooldowns, common failures also recurred at configured 0.25 RPS. The latest three origins were toray.co.jp robots, kuraray.co.jp robots and progresstech-group.jp body; a fixed set of three affected companies is not supported.

The diagnostic at configured 0.25 RPS has near-time Katakura/Pepper body HTTP 200 responses, Shinyei/Festaria robots TLS 503 and CSMen robots ordinary 503. Its final Katakura body was not fetched: only redirect/robots responses were saved for that case.
These differences do not establish the cause of the internal tunnel failure, disprove intermediary throttling or identify a published RPS threshold.
The controller total is a subset of collection-runs totals. Diagnostics are a separate 12 GETs and the initial summary of 9 GETs is not added a second time.
Saved runtime unknown was present during both successful collection and cooldown after common failures; it is not treated as proof that network policy was enforced.
The first post-30-minute-cooldown batch completed 30 companies at configured 0.25 RPS with 140 actual GETs and no common503 or429. Later running batches remain intermediate observations.
Exact URL matching shows Progress Technologies body 503→200 and Toray robots 503→302 (not robots200). Kuraray.com robots200 cannot be compared as the same URL to earlier kuraray.co.jp robots503.

At the frozen post-cap observation, the first 0.35 RPS trial batch completed 60 companies and 372 GETs without common503 or429. The later child collector reduced to 0.28 then 0.25 after ordinary http_503 responses at individual origins; the wrapper state still recorded 0.35.
